name: coffee-grinder-extension
description: Chrome extension that converts grind settings between coffee grinders via a micron scale.

scripts.build: npm run build:data && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.dev: npm run build:data && vite build --watch --mode development
scripts.verify: npm run check:data && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
